title: Structural MRI, Resting-state fMRI, and PSG/EEG Dataset of Zoster-associated Neuralgia
description: This dataset contains anatomical T1-weighted MRI, raw multi-echo resting-state fMRI, and polysomnography (PSG) EEG recordings from healthy controls and patients with zoster-associated neuralgia (ZAN). It supports investigation of brain structure, functional activity, and sleep differences between HC and ZAN groups. MRI and PSG data partly overlap across participants, and sleep stages were manually scored according to AASM criteria.
methods_description: T1w images were defaced and functional data are raw multi-echo BOLD converted with dcm2niix. PSG/EEG was recorded with linked mastoid references (M1/M2), and sleep stages (W, N1, N2, N3, REM) were manually scored following AASM criteria.
